caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle rendered in shades of brown, with visible grain patterns indicative of wood texture. The cradle is shown in profile, facing right, and has a high, curved headboard with a scroll-like design at the top, while the footboard is lower and features a similar, though less pronounced, curve. The sides of the cradle are solid with a handle-like oval cutout near the top edge of each side, toward the head. The cradle rests on four legs that are angled outward, with two horizontal rails providing support above the legs. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present. The artist’s signature, "Leonard Baskin," appears in small letters near the bottom right of the image.
title: Cradle
